topic: Trips & experiences + past simple for a finished period（旅行經驗＋for 一段已結束時間用過去式）

shadow.speaker: Puma Shen 沈伯洋（2026 年 9 月接受美國 Talking Taiwan 節目主持人 Felicia Lynn 的英文專訪，談 7 月的訪美行程；Talking Taiwan 官方 YouTube）

chunks.text: So we visited Los Angeles and DC and New York, right?
So there are several places that we visited.
So one of the reason that why we paid this visit is that because I'm currently, I'm still a legislator,
and it's kind of important that we exchange with other legislator talking about national defense, national security issue. So that's what we did in DC.

phrases.zh: 去拜訪、去一趟（比 visit 更口語；過去式 paid a visit）
那就是我們（在……）做的事。用來總結一段已經結束的經驗，動詞用過去式 did

respond.prompt_en: Tell me about a trip you took. Where did you go, and what did you do there? Answer in one sentence.
respond.prompt_zh: 說說你去過的一趟旅行：去了哪裡、做了什麼？用一句英文回答（旅行已經結束，所以用過去式！例如 Last summer we visited…, and that's what we did in…）

vocab.example: Last weekend we paid a visit to my grandparents in Tainan.
vocab.note: 沈伯洋原句：one of the reasons why we paid this visit…（pay → paid → paid，不是 payed！）。拜訪「地方或人」要加 to：pay a visit to Japan；但 visit 當動詞不加 to：visit Japan。

vocab.example: The legislators spent hours discussing the new law.
vocab.note: 沈伯洋原句：I'm still a legislator.（他是立委）。同字根：legislate（立法 v.）、legislation（法律、立法 n.）、the Legislative Yuan（立法院）。

vocab.example: Our class exchanged ideas with students from a school in Japan.
vocab.note: 沈伯洋原句：we exchange with other legislators。常用搭配：exchange A for B（用 A 換 B）、exchange ideas with sb（和某人交流想法）、an exchange student（交換學生）。

vocab.example: My sister is currently studying in Canada.
vocab.note: 沈伯洋原句：I'm currently, I'm still a legislator. ⚠️ currently＝「現在」，常配現在式/現在進行式；不要和 actually（其實）搞混。形容詞 current（目前的）：the current mayor。

vocab.example: We accomplished our goal of reading ten books in a month.
vocab.note: 同一段訪問：the last thing that we accomplished there…。accomplish a goal / a task＝達成目標/任務（比 finish 更強調「成功做到」）。名詞 accomplishment（成就）。

grammar.title: 過去簡單式 vs 現在完成式：for a week / for 111 days 不一定是完成式！
grammar.explain:
111 年會考「Ariel ___ every night for a week before her Chinese test」全國答對率只有 35%！很多人一看到 for 就選完成式。
① for＋一段時間只告訴你「多久」，不告訴你時態。要問：這段時間「結束了沒」？
② 已經結束的一段時間 → 過去簡單式：Ariel studied for a week before the test（考試已經考完、還拿了好成績 got）。Kevin ran for 111 days and finally finished in 2007。
③ 一直延續到現在 → 現在完成式：I have lived here for ten years.（現在還住這裡）
④ 句子裡的其他動詞也是線索：and got a very good grade、finally finished 都是過去式 → 整件事已經結束，前面也用過去式。
⑤ 今天的一部分也可能已結束：this afternoon（現在已經晚上了）→ I did most of it this afternoon。
🔑 判斷法：找「結束的證據」——過去的日期、已發生的結果、故事裡其他過去式動詞。
⭐ 沈伯洋原句：We visited Los Angeles and DC and New York… That's what we did in DC.（7 月的行程已經結束 → 過去式）
examples: Ariel studied every night for a week before her Chinese test and got a very good grade. —— 111 會考：考試已結束＋got → studied（答對率 35%）
Kevin Lin started to run across the Sahara Desert in November, 2006. He ran for 111 days, and finally finished his run on February 21, 2007. —— 111 補考：2006–2007 已結束 → ran
So we visited Los Angeles and DC and New York, right? —— 沈伯洋原句：7 月訪美已結束 → visited

practice.question: My grandfather ___ in Japan for five years when he was young. Now he lives in Taichung.
practice.explanation: when he was young＋Now he lives in Taichung＝在日本工作那五年已經結束 → 過去式 worked。has worked 表示「到現在還在」，但他現在住台中，所以不對。

uoe.passage: Last summer, my family ___1___ a visit to my uncle in Tokyo. We stayed there ___2___ ten days, and every day felt like an adventure. We ___3___ several museums and even took a cooking class. On the last night, my uncle asked me what I had ___4___ during the trip. I told him I had finally learned to order food in Japanese all by myself!

gaps.explanation: Last summer＝已結束的時間 → 過去式。pay 的過去式是 paid（不是 payed，拼字陷阱！）；have paid 是完成式，不能和 last summer 一起用。
ten days 是「一段時間」→ for ten days。since 後面接時間「點」；during 接名詞（during the trip）；ago 要放在時間後面（ten days ago）而且意思不合。⚠️ 這裡有 for，但旅行已結束，所以動詞用過去式 stayed，不是完成式！
整段在講去年夏天已經結束的旅行，後面也是 took → 過去式 visited。have visited 不能用在已結束的時間。
what I had accomplished＝我在旅行中「達成了什麼」，下一句回答「終於學會自己用日文點餐」→ accomplished。exchanged 交換；currently 是副詞，不能放在 had 後面；survived 活下來，意思不合。

quiz.question: Ariel ___ every night for a week before her Chinese test and got a very good grade.
quiz.explanation: 考試已經結束（and got a very good grade 是過去式）→ 那一週的讀書也結束了 → studied。⚠️ 看到 for a week 就選 has studied 是最大陷阱，全國答對率只有 35%！

quiz.question: Kevin Lin started to run across the Sahara Desert in November, 2006. He ___ for 111 days, and finally finished his run on February 21, 2007.
quiz.explanation: 2006 年 11 月到 2007 年 2 月，早就結束了，還有 finally finished → 過去簡單式 ran。has run 表示到現在還在跑，不合理；was running 要有另一個過去時間點打斷。

quiz.question: Mom: Linda, you've been playing computer games all evening! Have you finished your report? Linda: Well, ___ most of it this afternoon, and I'll finish it by Friday.
quiz.explanation: 現在是晚上（all evening），this afternoon 已經過去了 → 過去式 I did。I'll do 是未來，和「下午已做」矛盾；I was doing 只說「當時正在做」，不表示已完成大部分。

quiz.question: During the trip, the mayor ___ a visit to a small school in the mountains.
quiz.explanation: During the trip（已結束的旅行）→ 過去式。pay → paid → paid，payed 不是正確拼法（拼字陷阱）；has paid 不配已結束的旅行。
quiz.source: vocab: pay a visit / 沈伯洋原句

quiz.question: The two schools ___ ideas about recycling last month, and both of them learned a lot.
quiz.explanation: exchange ideas＝交流想法 → exchanged。accomplished 達成（目標），不能接 ideas；survived 活下來；legislated 立法，都不合。last month → 過去式。

quiz.question: My brother ___ in Kaohsiung for three years, but he moved back to Taipei last year.
quiz.explanation: he moved back to Taipei last year＝住高雄那三年已經結束 → 過去式 lived。has lived 表示「到現在還住高雄」，和搬回台北矛盾。會考最愛用 for 騙你選完成式！
quiz.source: 會考 trap: for + finished period (仿 111會考#19)

dialog.greet: Good morning, Roby! Did you sleep well? 早安，Roby！今天也一起加油吧！
dialog.present: Today: 'for a week' — finished or not? 今天的重點：for 一段時間，要先看它結束了沒！
correct: Excellent! You spotted the finished time. 太棒了，你看出時間已經結束了！
Well done — that's exactly right! 完全正確，好厲害！
Great job! The trap didn't catch you. 很好，陷阱沒騙到你！
wrong: Almost! Is that time over now? 差一點！那段時間現在結束了嗎？
No worries — mistakes help us learn. 沒關係，錯誤會讓我們進步。
Look at the other verbs in the sentence. 看看句子裡其他動詞是什麼時態。
dialog.hint: Don't stop at 'for'. Look for a finished result or a past date. 別只看到 for 就停，找找已經結束的結果或過去的日期。
dialog.submit: Let's check your answers together. 我們一起來對答案吧！
dialog.done: You worked hard today — I'm proud of you! 你今天很認真，我以你為榮！
